title: رصد آمن
rule:
Applies when: For consequential tool use.
Record enough observable intent, result and correlation to diagnose behavior without storing secrets or private chain-of-thought.
rationale: الرصد قد يكشف أسراراً أو تفكيراً داخلياً غير مصرح بحفظه. PROVISIONAL_OWNER_REVIEW
reviewCadence: Owner review before activation and after material changes
